sections.shortTitle: The Sehwan Development Authority Revival and Amending Act 2013
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE SEHWAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
THE SEHWAN
DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(REVIVAL AND
AMENDING) ACT, 2013
SINDH
ACT NO. LVIII OF 2013
KARACHI, THE 19TH DECEMBER, 2013.
AN
ACT
NO.PAS/Legis-B-18/2013---The
Sehwan Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Bill,
2013 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 19th September, 2013 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 27th November, 2013 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh. to revive and amend the law
relating to the Sehwan Development Authority.
Preamble.-
WHEREAS in order to give impetus and encourage the housing industry and
provide shelter to the people of the Province, it is expedient to revive and
amend the Sehwan Development Authority Act, 1993, in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may
be called the Sehwan Development Authority (Revival
and Amending), Act, 2013.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Sehwan Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Bill, 2013 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 19th September, 2013 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 27th November, 2013 is hereby published as an Act
of the Legislature of Sindh. to revive and amend the law relating to the Sehwan
Development Authority.
Preamble.- WHEREAS in
order to give impetus and encourage the housing industry and provide shelter to
the people of the Province, it is expedient to revive and amend the Sehwan
Development Authority Act, 1993, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
7. Saving.-- All orders
made, proceedings taken, appointments, made, acts done by any authority, or by
any person, which were made, taken or done, or purported to have been made,
taken or done between the first day of July, two thousand two, and the date on
which this Act comes into force (both days inclusive), shall, notwithstanding
any judgment of any court, be deemed to be and always to have been validly
made, taken or done under the Sehwan Development Authority Act, 1993and shall
not be called in question in any court or forum on any ground whatsoever.
